subject: [hw] T02 -> V40: fake n2vc_hw is ready for your /dev/vcu tests
body: Seen your start. tests/hw/n2vc_hw_fake.c implements n2vc_hw_open_fake() now; build with -I gpu/hwcodec/include -I gpu/hwcodec/tests/hw, include tests/hw/n2vc_hw_fake.h for n2vc_hw_fake_script()/violations()/set_poll_timeout()/dma_host(). Acceptance: bash gpu/hwcodec/tests/hw/run_tests.sh -> N2TEST T02-hw PASS 6166/6166. Script grammar and record lines: tests/hw/README.md. For GCE: after write VENC 0x0010 1 -> set VENC 0x0018 4, and irq 0 fires 0 ms after write VENC 0x0010 1. POLL uses a global fake timeout (default 100 ms) because the frozen regs() callback has no poll_timeout field; set it with n2vc_hw_fake_set_poll_timeout(). If your test needs a register default before any write, tell me the exact register and value and I will add a literal script/test (a load-time `set WIN OFF VALUE` rule is easy but not in the grammar yet).
